_about: Spoken Q&A about a CV. Copy to cv_qa.json and replace with real content. Each item: several phrasings of one question and one spoken answer (third person, 1-3 short sentences, written for speech: no URLs, symbols or abbreviations the voice can't say). Items with "unknown": true teach the model to say it doesn't know instead of inventing facts. Anything here can be said to any visitor: leave private details (phone, address) out. Ada Example is a made-up person.

items.answer: Ada Example is a software engineer who builds speech and language tools. She has ten years of experience in startups and research labs.
I'm a voice assistant on Ada Example's website. You can ask me about her work, her education and her projects.
She studied computer science at an example university, and later did a master's degree in machine learning.
Her CV doesn't say her age, so I can't tell you that.
That's not in her CV. You'd need to ask her directly.
